title: PM2 global error caught
body:
I am using Pm2 version 2.7.1, Node v6.11.4, Centos 7
and I have a crash

```
2017-10-24 13:46:30: --- PM2 global error caught ---------------------------------------------------
2017-10-24 13:46:30: Time                 : Tue Oct 24 2017 13:46:30 GMT+0700 (+07)
2017-10-24 13:46:30: Cannot read property 'on' of undefined
2017-10-24 13:46:30: TypeError: Cannot read property 'on' of undefined
    at /data/software/nodejs/node-v6.11.4-linux-x64/lib/node_modules/pm2/lib/God/ForkMode.js:109:18
    at /data/software/nodejs/node-v6.11.4-linux-x64/lib/node_modules/pm2/node_modules/async/dist/async.js:421:16

    at /data/software/nodejs/node-v6.11.4-linux-x64/lib/node_modules/pm2/node_modules/async/dist/async.js:906:16

Error: spawn node EAGAIN
```

any help. Thanks :)
